rules.statement: For each outsourced processing, state the processor (수탁자, including sub-processors) and the task outsourced.
Name processors concretely; never abbreviate with "~등".
With many processors, use a separate screen, downloadable list, or a web page link listing tasks and processors.
Only where the data subject can see the actual processor in a service menu or my-page, the policy may give that access path, the task, and the processor type in plain language.
Sub-processors and their tasks may be disclosed by linking the processor's own privacy policy.
Overseas outsourcing may be written in S10 marked as outsourcing; then add a pointer here.

rules.element: ambiguous party: manual review, both candidates
rules.statement: Parties of an ambiguous type (PG, marketplace seller, external LLM/API vendor, plug-in or SDK provider), parties whose own-purpose use is 'yes' or 'unknown', and parties named both as processor and recipient are never classified automatically. Raise flag ambiguity.delegation_vs_provision, draft both the S09 outsourcing row and the S07 provision row, and route the section to the reviewer.

check.expr: flagged('ambiguity.delegation_vs_provision', party) => section.S09.status=='manual_review' && hasRow(S09, party) && hasRow(S07, party) && !chosen(party)

rules.sourceSpan: n/a (user decision 2026-09-30; the guideline gives no ruling, see NV-S09-01)

requires: link to full list of processors and tasks

options.when: subject can see the actual processor in service menu or my-page

conditionalTyping.notAllowed: Processor type without an access path to the actual processor.

changeNoticeLink: Minor processor-list changes may be batched in S24 notices (e.g. every 4 weeks) with start and end dates per processor.
goodPatterns: Typing example (paraphrase): processor = 'the phone shop or agency you signed up with', task = subscription changes and billing support; actual shop shown under menu > my subscription info.

Supporting clauses: contract terms under PIPA 26 (purpose limitation, safeguards, sub-outsourcing limits, supervision, liability); sub-outsourcing with consent under 26(6); changes published without delay.

commonDefects.defect: Not all processors disclosed, or '○○ 등' used.
Task column missing or vague ('업무 처리').
Cloud or overseas processor omitted (often surfaces only in S10 or A1).

processorOwnPolicyNote: Under PIPA 26(8) the processor must itself publish a policy including its officer and sub-processors (context for B2B/processor clients).
extractionHints: vendor names: hosting/cloud, call center, delivery, messaging, CRM
my-page paths that show the vendor

needsVerification.note: Classifying PG/payment, delivery and marketplace sellers as outsourcing vs provision is fact-dependent; the guideline gives no ruling. Flag manual review when the interview answer is ambiguous.
needsVerification.resolution: Handled by flag ambiguity.delegation_vs_provision (always manual review, both candidates drafted) per user decision 2026-09-30.

flags.decidedBy: User decision 2026-09-30 (PM Row 4c): always manual review, never a silent choice.
rowTriggers: any(privacy.S09_roleAssessment, r => r.partyType in ['pg','marketplace_seller','external_llm_api','plugin_sdk'] || r.ownPurposeUse in ['yes','unknown'])
match(evidence, lex.ambiguousPartyRole) && classification not stated by the speaker

draftBehavior.marking: Each candidate row carries an AST note {kind: 'manual_review', code: 'ambiguity.delegation_vs_provision'}; neither candidate is marked as chosen. Missing provision fields (purpose, retention, basis) stay as placeholders, not guesses.
draftBehavior.audit: C1/C2 must not report 'wrong section' defects (D-S07-03) for a flagged party until the reviewer resolves the flag.

reviewerMessage.ko: [위탁·제3자 제공 구분 필요] '{party}'({partyTypeLabel})은(는) 개인정보 처리위탁(우리 대신 처리)인지 제3자 제공(업체가 자기 목적으로 이용)인지 자동으로 판단하지 않았습니다. 초안에 두 가지 안(제9조 위탁 표, 제7조 제3자 제공 표)을 모두 넣었습니다. 계약서와 실제 데이터 흐름(업체가 받은 정보를 자기 목적으로 쓰는지, 이용자와 직접 계약하는지, 업체 약관의 데이터 이용 조항, 해외 이전 여부)을 확인한 뒤 한 가지를 고르고 나머지 안은 지워 주세요.
reviewerMessage.en: [Outsourcing vs provision] '{party}' ({partyTypeLabel}) was not auto-classified. The draft contains both candidates (S09 outsourcing row, S07 provision row). Check the contract and the actual data flow, keep one and delete the other.
